name: Kodi
summary: Media centre for a television screen

config.notes: The userdata directory carries settings, add-ons and the library database. sources.xml and guisettings.xml hold absolute media paths and platform-specific audio devices, so it is kept aside. On Fedora and openSUSE Kodi comes from RPM Fusion and Packman, which are not official repositories; use the Flatpak there.
